sentences.text: Serena Jameka Williams -LRB- born September 26 , 1981 -RRB- is an American professional tennis player .	tennis	tennis

The Women 's Tennis Association -LRB- WTA -RRB- has ranked her world no. 1 in singles on eight occasions , from 2002 to 2017 .	2017	2017 Australian Open – Women's Singles	2002	2002 Wimbledon Championships – Women's Doubles	WTA	Women's Tennis Association
She became the world no. 1 for the first time on July 8 , 2002 .	2002	2002 Wimbledon Championships – Women's Doubles

On the sixth occasion , she held the ranking for 186 consecutive weeks , tying the record set by Steffi Graf for the most consecutive weeks as world no. 1 by a female tennis player .	tennis	tennis	Steffi Graf	Steffi Graf

In total , she has been world no. 1 for 319 weeks , which ranks her third in the Open Era among female tennis players .	tennis	tennis	third in the Open Era	Open Era tennis records – women's singles	Open Era	Open Era
Williams ' accomplishments and success in professional tennis have led some commentators , players , and sports writers to regard her as the greatest female tennis player of all time .	tennis	tennis
Williams holds the most Grand Slam titles in singles , doubles , and mixed doubles combined amongst active players .	Grand Slam	Grand Slam (tennis)
Her record of 39 Grand Slam titles puts her third on the all-time list and second in the open era : 23 in singles , 14 in women 's doubles , and 2 in mixed doubles .	Grand Slam	Grand Slam (tennis)

She is the most recent female player to have held all four Grand Slam singles titles simultaneously -LRB- 2002 -- 03 and 2014 -- 15 -RRB- and the third player to achieve this record twice after Rod Laver and Steffi Graf .	2002	2002 Wimbledon Championships – Women's Doubles	2014	2014 WTA Finals – Singles	Steffi Graf	Steffi Graf	Grand Slam	Grand Slam (tennis)	Rod Laver	Rod Laver

She is also the most recent player , together with her sister Venus Williams , to have held all four Grand Slam women 's doubles titles simultaneously -LRB- 2009 -- 10 -RRB- .	2009	2009 WTA Tour Championships	Grand Slam	Grand Slam (tennis)	Venus Williams	Venus Williams

Her total of 23 Grand Slam singles titles marks the record for the most Grand Slam wins by a tennis player in the Open Era , and is second on the all-time list behind Margaret Court -LRB- 24 -RRB- .	tennis	tennis	Grand Slam	Grand Slam (tennis)	Open Era	Open Era	second on the all-time	List of Grand Slam women's singles champions#Most Grand Slam tournament singles titles	Margaret Court	Margaret Court

She is the only tennis player in history -LRB- man or woman -RRB- to have won singles titles at least six times in three of the four Grand Slam tournaments , and the only player ever to have won two of the four Grand Slams seven times each -LRB- seven Wimbledon titles and seven Australian Open titles -RRB- .	tennis	tennis	Grand Slam	Grand Slam (tennis)	Australian Open	Australian Open
She is also the only tennis player to have won 10 Grand Slam singles titles in two separate decades .	tennis	tennis	Grand Slam	Grand Slam (tennis)
She has won an all-time record of 13 Grand Slam singles titles on hardcourt .	Grand Slam	Grand Slam (tennis)	hardcourt	hardcourt

Williams holds the Open Era record for most titles won at the Australian Open -LRB- 7 -RRB- and shares the Open Era record for most titles won at the US Open with Chris Evert -LRB- 6 -RRB- .	US Open	US Open (tennis)	Open Era	Open Era	Australian Open	Australian Open	Chris Evert	Chris Evert

She also holds an all-time record for the most singles matches won at the Grand Slams -LRB- man or woman -RRB- with 316 matches -LRB- through the 2017 Australian Open -RRB- .	2017	2017 Australian Open – Women's Singles	Australian Open	Australian Open
She has won 14 Grand Slam doubles titles with her sister Venus , and the pair are unbeaten in Grand Slam doubles finals .	Grand Slam	Grand Slam (tennis)

As a team , she and Venus have the third most women 's doubles grand slam titles , behind the 18 titles of Natasha Zvereva -LRB- 14 with Gigi Fernández -RRB- and the record 20 titles won by Martina Navratilova and Pam Shriver .	Natasha Zvereva	Natasha Zvereva
